overall_reason: The system UI stack (Segoe UI drew every glyph at 1440 per fonts.json; system-ui computed at 375) sets every role, which fits a product-UI (Operate) composition, but each event's meta line sits 10px below its title and 10px above the next title, so the title-meta pairs come apart.

score.reason: T-LADDER fails on spacing: the size and weight steps are clear (14/550 head, 12/450 titles, 10/400 meta), but the meta lines float halfway between rows.

findings.title: Create hierarchy with size, weight and space
findings.evidence: In dom-1440.json 'Design review' ends at y=84 and its meta 'Maya and Jon' starts at y=94 (10px gap); the meta ends at y=110 and the next title 'Customer call' starts at y=120 (another 10px gap). The tile P29/01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png shows each meta line equidistant from two titles.
findings.before: Meta line 10px below its own title and 10px above the next title
findings.after: Meta line 0 to 2px below its title, with the row gap (about 16px) carried between events
findings.why: With equal gaps the reader cannot tell which title 'Maya and Jon' or 'Ana · 30 minutes' belongs to.

strengths: Clear size steps: head 14px/550, event titles 12px/450, times and meta 10px/400.
Times sit in their own left column, and the stylesheet sets tabular-nums.
not_investigated: T-MEASURE: no paragraph of 3 or more lines at either width
Size floors under 12px (A11-002) and contrast belong to the sweep and the color lens; not repeated here
T-FIGURES: the times are a list, not compared figures; tabular-nums is set
